entity.name: Heshan Jayakody
entity.description: Maintainer of Mudal, a privacy-first SMS expense tracker for Sri Lanka and a fork of the PennyWise AI project.

projects.name: Mudal
projects.description: Mudal turns the transaction SMS that Sri Lankan banks already send into categorised, searchable financial records. Parsing, storage and the optional on-device AI assistant (a local Qwen 2.5 model via LiteRT-LM) run entirely on the device: no account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking SDKs. The only network use is optional exchange-rate lookup for multi-currency features. It is a fork of PennyWise AI (AGPL-3.0-only) focused on Sri Lankan banks, with no paywall and no feature limits.
